title: Laminar water flow in a tube heated with a uniform wall heat flux
goal: The first case with heat transfer.
story: Solved with OpenFOAM. gpucfd cannot solve it yet: it has no temperature equation and no round pipe.

requirements: Water flows slowly through a small tube. After an unheated entrance, the wall is heated evenly.
Asked for: how the heat transfer develops along the tube, its final value, the length of the thermal entrance, and the wall and water temperatures.
Reference: the exact series solution of this problem.

results.headline: WARN. The simulated local Nusselt number matches the exact solution to \(0.005\,\%\) (RMS, finest mesh), the fully developed value to \(+0.011\,\%\) and the 5 % entrance length \(60.1\,D\) to \(-0.067\,\%\).
meaning: OpenFOAM matches the exact solution of a heat-transfer problem to about a hundredth of a per cent.
The verdict is WARN. The numbers agree, and the full report lists what was not checked.
limits: gpucfd has no column: heat transfer is not built into it yet.
The fluid's properties are constant, and buoyancy was checked on one grid only.
